# Neoncite/UI

Neoncite/UI is a dark-only React source-component design system for developer tools, AI products, infrastructure, observability, and technical dashboards.

Canonical website: https://neoncite-ui.thorus.workers.dev/
Documentation: https://neoncite-ui.thorus.workers.dev/docs/
Components: https://neoncite-ui.thorus.workers.dev/components
Blocks: https://neoncite-ui.thorus.workers.dev/blocks
Theme Builder: https://neoncite-ui.thorus.workers.dev/themes
Registry index: https://neoncite-ui.thorus.workers.dev/r/index.json
Repository: https://github.com/brunopetrovic/NeonciteUI

## AI implementation rules

- Reuse existing Neoncite components before inventing new controls.
- Preserve dark-only OLED surfaces, machined rim-light treatment, and semantic neon accents.
- Never generate a light theme or generic beige/pastel shadcn styling.
- Prefer composition of registered primitives and Blocks.
- Respect keyboard navigation, focus management, ARIA semantics, and reduced motion.
- Use semantic CSS variables/tokens rather than hardcoded replacement palettes.
- Inspect registry source before installation when trust/security matters.

## Distribution

Use the CLI:

npx neoncite@latest init -y
npx neoncite add button combobox terminal
npx neoncite add telemetry-dashboard
npx neoncite add theme-ocean

Registry item types include registry:ui, registry:block, and registry:theme.
Official dark theme presets: Neoncite, Ocean, Ember, Forest, Ultraviolet.

Each component page documents installation, API/props, states, accessibility, keyboard interactions when applicable, tokens, SSR/RTL notes, and canonical source.
